thread:
Maria (CS): FYI — a subset of onboarding customers experienced delayed indexing between 02:40-03:15 UTC. Preparing a customer-facing status update + RCA draft. Need: renewal-risk language, credit guidance, and enablement reschedule plan.

Josh - CS Ops: Which tenants are impacted? We should segment: high-touch (paid), trials, and self-serve so comms are targeted.

Maria (CS): Initial high-touch list: acct-alpha, acct-beta, acct-gamma. ~12 trials hit large bulk imports. I'll post the full tenant CSV in #cs-ops-docs in ~10m.

Priya (Support): Proposed offer: 1-week onboarding extension + 10% service credit for high-touch. Trials: 1-month extension + waived overage for affected import. Need contact cadence for follow-up.

Ben (SRE): Root cause: rate-limiter regression in embed-ingest worker after recent rollout; created a processing backlog. Fix deployed (revert + parallelism bump) at 03:05 UTC. Backfills started; ETA ~6h initially, updating now with metrics. Formal RCA to follow.

Leah (Product): Recommend we offer temporary priority reroute to a dedicated embed pool for high-touch accounts for 48h. Ops + Billing signoff required for any dedicated resource tagging.

Maria (CS): Draft customer snippet for review — please edit: "We're sorry — indexing for some onboarding imports was delayed due to an internal processing issue. Engineering implemented a fix and we are backfilling queued items. We will follow up with an estimated completion time and next steps. For high-touch customers, we will proactively schedule enablement and apply a one-week onboarding extension plus a service credit."

Josh - CS Ops: For renewal-risk customers we should add: "We understand this may impact your go-live. We'll assign a dedicated success lead and escalate priority until your imports complete. Credits and scheduling flexibility are available; we'll coordinate directly with your team." Stronger reassurance there.

Ben (SRE): Suggested technical blurb for an FAQ section: "Cause: rate-limit config regression in embed-ingest worker introduced a backlog. Fix: reverted the offending commit and increased processing concurrency. Mitigation: continuous backfill and adjusted throttling. We'll add test coverage and a deploy guard to prevent recurrence."

Priya (Support): Action item: I need a CSV with columns: account, impact-severity (high/medium/low), owner, contact-email, trial/paid. Can I get that by 11:00am PT? I'll run the segmented send after CS signoff.

Maria (CS): Uploading CSV to #cs-ops-docs now. @Leah can you confirm billing credit policy? @Ben please confirm backfill ETA after next progress update.

Leah (Product): :thumbsup: Billing pre-approves up to 15% credit for accounts under $5k MRR. Above that, AM approval required. If we enable dedicated pool, we need a billing tag and AM notif.

Ben (SRE): Progress update 04:20 UTC — 45% of queued imports processed. New ETA ~3-4 hours for trials, faster for smaller jobs. I'll post progress every 30m. Relevant log stream: `embed-ingest/backfill`.

Josh - CS Ops: I'll draft two email templates (high-touch + renewal-risk version, and trial version) and share in 15m for quick edits.

Comms Bot: Draft uploaded to #cs-review (link) — requesting signoff from @Maria (CS), @Leah (Product), and @Ben (SRE). :mailbox_with_mail:

Maria (CS): After signoff I'll send to impacted accounts and schedule enablement slots for high-touch customers. Also want to capture customer feedback — will include a 2-question survey: "Did this impact your go-live?" and an optional comment box.

Priya (Support): I'll wire the post-email automation to include the survey link and capture responses into our CS tracker.

Ben (SRE): Postmortem ETA: end of day tomorrow. Will include root cause, timeline, and a set of action items (owners + due dates).

Maria (CS): Reminder: when sending credit approvals, cc billing@redwood.com for audit. Also flag any renewal-risk accounts so AMs can be looped in.

Leah (Product): Will loop AMs for >$5k MRR accounts. Thanks everyone. :heart:

Maria (CS): OK — moving to send after we get the last signoff. I'll post final message here with the send time and list of recipients.

Josh - CS Ops: Noted. I'll queue the templates and tag the high-touch cadence in the calendar.

Priya (Support): I'll stand by to monitor replies and route urgent asks to the on-call success lead.

Ben (SRE): Updating channel in 30m with new progress.

Maria (CS): Closing loop — thanks team, this is the plan we're executing.
